thread:
ben: Heads-up: noticed a weird charge spike in the console for customer 'acme-inc' during a streaming session. looks like prefetch + truncation interaction. cc @jordan @anya

ben: billing delta jumped ~2.1x right after a reconnect. not seeing extra tokens in the app logs, so suspect attribution.

jordan: can you paste the request id and a minimal log chunk? also which model and truncation point?

ben: request_id: r-0a1b2c3d, model: redwood-open-13b, stream=true, prefetch=true, truncation: client-side at 2048 tokens.

ben: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T16:02:12Z INFO stream:start id=r-0a1b2c3d session=sess-77 route=/api/v1/generate
2026-03-20T16:02:13Z INFO stream:reconnect id=r-0a1b2c3d session=sess-77 reason=network-err
2026-03-20T16:02:14Z INFO stream:truncated id=r-0a1b2c3d truncated_at=2048 prefetch_hit=true
```

jordan: ok. console shows a billing event with token_delta=4870, while the trace tokens emitted are ~2300. that's the 2x you're seeing.

anya: @ben do we know if router did a fallback to a different variant on reconnect? could be switching to a quantized vs fp path that we bill differently.

ben: I checked model catalog on the request: pinned to redwood-open-13b:v3. no swap recorded. router logs show a handoff to node group 'prefetch-sidecar' during reconnect.

mira: we saw something similar last week but with ephemeral toolcall suffixes — double counting when a resumed stream caused both main path and sidecar to emit ledger entries.

kai: ops-bot: recent router change merged yesterday — commit d4f8. It added a prefetch handoff for long-running sessions.

jordan: so potential blame: duplicate ledger events from handoff + resumed main path, or missing dedupe in the billing pipeline when truncation causes a toolcall boundary. We need faster repro telemetry.

anya: action items: 1) add per-session token attribution in traces (session_id tag on ledger events), 2) add a heuristic metric: "stream_reconnect_token_ratio" for spikes, 3) console change to surface suspicious >1.5x deltas with link to traces.

ben: +1. small UX ask: show the last router path on the charge detail (e.g., prefetched-sidecar -> main-worker) so SREs can spot handoffs quickly.

mira: also request internal API change: include origin_session header on resume RPCs so downstream services can dedupe by origin_session + sequence_id.

jordan: Origin header is fine but careful about rollout: clients and sidecars must honor it. propose conservative rollout: start emitting header, but don't change dedupe logic until metric observed stable.

anya: agree. let's gate by a feature flag on routing to avoid global impact. Kai, can ops-bot add a temporary flag?

kai: ops-bot: created ff:prefetch_session_origin (off). will enable in canary for cluster-a at 09:00 PST tomorrow.

ben: i'll add an internal dashboard tile that computes token_delta / emitted_tokens over 6h windows for customers with prefetch enabled. will also surface when >1.5x for quick triage.

mira: i'll open a short-run alert for any customer with >1.8x for two consecutive windows. low-noise.

jordan: final note: before rolling to prod, add a small end-to-end test that simulates reconnect+truncation with prefetch on and asserts ledger emits a single attribution event. otherwise we risk charging customers double.

ben: sounds good. i'll file the ticket (ENG-PLAT-9821) and attach the sample logs. thanks all :thumbsup:
